source_window.resource_title: Target-specific INSPIRE WMS GetFeatureInfo feature-identification window around verified Forge Cottage point
source_window.data_date: Official HM Land Registry INSPIRE view-service/dataset semantics; target request attempted 2026-10-06
source_window.license: UK Open Government Licence (OGL) for INSPIRE Index Polygons

field_evidence.dataset_semantics: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons represent the position and indicative extent of registered freehold properties in England and Wales and use Land Registry-INSPIRE identifiers related to registered titles.
field_evidence.target_basis: Forge Cottage has the verified producer point POINT (0.910196 51.073494), approximately E=603968.556, N=134491.689 in EPSG:27700; the request uses the same 200 metre target window as the earlier portrayal attempt but a different WMS operation.
field_evidence.request_method: An unused WMS GetFeatureInfo request targets the centre pixel of the bbox with QUERY_LAYERS=inspire:CP.CadastralParcel and INFO_FORMAT=application/vnd.ogc.gml, seeking feature-level information rather than a portrayal image.
field_evidence.transport_result: The exact public/no-login GetFeatureInfo URL could not be opened by the available web transport. A direct network attempt also failed at DNS resolution for inspire.landregistry.gov.uk, so no GML feature response, Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, title-linked identifier, polygon or bbox was returned.
field_evidence.legal_extent_limit: HM Land Registry states that INSPIRE Index Polygons are indicative and do not establish the legal extent contained in a registered title.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Without a retrieved target-specific feature response and an authoritative target parcel/title geometry binding, no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted; spatial binding/materialization remains local OpenCode work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. An unused official HM Land Registry INSPIRE WMS GetFeatureInfo request was targeted at the verified Forge Cottage point to obtain feature-level cadastral/index-polygon information rather than a portrayal image, but the exact public/no-login request could not be retrieved through the available web transport and direct network resolution also failed, so no target Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, title-linked feature, polygon or bbox was obtained. Local OpenCode/GIS must retrieve and bind the exact target registered-title/index polygon or another authoritative target parcel/title polygon; after canonical bbox is bound, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from the monthly Ashford GML source-area inventory to a target-specific WMS GetFeatureInfo feature-identification request centred on the verified Forge Cottage location. The request is distinct from earlier GetCapabilities and GetMap fingerprints. The official endpoint could not be retrieved by the available web transport, and direct network resolution for the service host also failed, returning no feature GML or identifier. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is inferred from the query window; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
